concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-005 name OQMD (Band Gap, Formation Energy) and AFLOW (Thermal Conductivity) as the required sources, but the only dataset-acquisition task (T002) fetches matbench_expt_gap, matbench_mp_e_form, and boltztrap_mp — none from OQMD or AFLOW. No task covers the spec's named sources; either the spec must be amended to name the matminer datasets or a task must fetch from OQMD/AFLOW. As written, an implementer following T002 cannot satisfy FR-001/SC-005.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs contracts/dataset.schema.yaml and plan.md:Data-Model Mapping
concerns.text: The plan maps download.py/featurize.py outputs to the MaterialsDataset entity via contracts/dataset.schema.yaml (fields n_samples, n_train, n_val, n_test, features, target, checksum), but no task produces an artifact conforming to that contract. T002 writes an ad-hoc <dataset_id>_metadata.json with a different field set (n_samples_original, n_samples_used, no split counts or features/target), and T003's split JSON is also not tied to the schema. The dataset.schema.yaml contract is left uncovered by any task.

NFR-003 and the plan require all dependencies pinned in requirements.txt, and the constitution requires a pinned requirements file under code/. No task creates or verifies requirements.txt — T011 only references 'the pinned requirements.txt' in documentation, and T009's coverage note claims NFR-003 is covered by T009/T011 but neither task actually writes or validates the pin file. Add a task (or extend T001/T009) to generate and verify requirements.txt.

concerns.location: tasks.md vs data-model.md:Data Flow step 3 and plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: The data model and plan specify trained model artifacts saved under results/models/ ('models/ → trained artefacts saved under results/models/'), but no task saves trained model artifacts — T003/T004 only persist per-sample predictions and registries. Either add artifact persistence to T004 or record a decision that models are not persisted (the data-model element is currently uncovered).
